text:
maria: FYI — HelixCorp CISO escalated POC blockers. They need a VPC/private deployment sketch, data residency confirmation (EU), and SLA numbers by EOD. Can we spin up a private trial or at least an architecture diagram? cc @miguel

miguel: On it. Do we have a current template for EU on-prem/VPC handoff? Need to know allowed egress ports and if they require customer-managed KMS.

rahul: quick answers: VPC peering is supported, customer NAT is preferred to avoid egress through our shared subnet. Port list: 443 outbound, 5222 for agent heartbeat. If they need private IP routing we'll need a cross-connect.

sophie: Legal — they mentioned 'data residency' in the CISO email. We need to confirm DPA + SCCs for EU. Also check if they require data-at-rest keys to be customer-managed (KMS/HSM).

elaine: Can we get an executive bridge? They asked to speak with someone who can approve a temporary SLA tweak for the POC. @jordan can you join if available? :pray:

jordan: I can do 4pm CET / 7am PT. I'll need a short brief: current throughput they expect, expected qps, and whether heavy KV cache persistence is required.

maria: Thanks. Customer expects ~50 rps peak, average 10 rps. Sequence length ~1k tokens. They will run evals that might spike for 1 hour windows.

miguel: For private trial option: propose Dedicated trial (1 GPU reserved) + VPC peering. Sharing rough config:
```
- model: rdx-bert-13b-quant
- gpu: 1xA10G
- reserved: 1xweek
- ingress: VPC peering, 443 only
- kms: optional BYO
```

miguel: Can infra confirm if A10G supports their 1k token profiles and kv cache size? @rahul

rahul: A10G should be ok for 1k seq for single instance, but for stable 50rps need at least 2 instances + autoscale buffer. Also need to set KV cache retention to 30m to avoid thrashing.

sophie: Legal will prep DPA + EU addendum draft. ETA: EOD unless there's additional redlines.

elaine: I'll schedule exec bridge for 4pm CET. Maria — can you invite HelixCorp CISO + Eng lead and send a short agenda (goals, ask list, what we can commit for POC)?

maria: on it. Draft agenda:
- intro + scope (5m)
- infra handoff: VPC peering, ports, KMS (10m)
- SLA ask and duration for trial (5m)
- next steps + signoff (5m)

maria: Also attaching the internal checklist link: https://redwood-internal/ops/poc-private-trial-checklist (internal)

ops-bot: runbook reminder — ensure ticket INFRA-948 is updated with peering CIDRs and contact points.

elaine: Great — assign tasks:
- miguel: produce config + perf notes by 2pm PT
- rahul: confirm infra capacity + autoscale recommendation by 2:30pm PT
- sophie: DPA draft by EOD
- maria: customer invite + agenda by 30m

maria: copied. Will ping again if CISO asks for a live demo during bridge.

miguel: I'll drop a quick perf run and post logs here. :thumbsup:

rahul: I'll open the infra ticket with tentative capacity and link back here.

sophie: If they ask for HSM attestation, escalate to security; I can start the questionnaire but will need input from infra.

elaine: Thanks team — let's aim to close the blockers in this bridge. :rocket:
